Class InputParser

java.lang.Object
chess.console.InputParser
public class InputParser extends Object
Converts raw text typed by the user into a Command.

Parsing never throws: any unrecognized or malformed input becomes an INVALID command with a message explaining the problem. Input is case-insensitive and surrounding whitespace is ignored.

Accepted input:

  • E2 E4 - move
  • moves E2 - list legal destinations
  • captured, history, board, reset, help
  • quit or exit
